bio_en: Hakob Garageozian, known as Zaven, was born in 1873 in Trabzon and educated at its national school; in 1889 he was one of a group of schoolboys who formed a society for 'the freedom of Armenia' and tried to run away to the homeland. Shaped by the Erzurum events and the Kum Kapu demonstration, he joined the local ARF groups on leaving school and in spring 1894 became a member and secretary of the Trabzon committee. After the attempt on Bahri Pasha and the massacre of 25 September 1895 he narrowly escaped death and was imprisoned for twenty days; pressed by his parents he left the city, but he later returned to the work. In 1897, cornered and called on to surrender, he answered with pistol fire and turned the last bullet on himself.
